agents.name: Skipper
agents.description: The captain. Runs the plan, sets priorities, and turns meetings into next actions.
examplePrompts: Turn these meeting notes into decisions and action items
Build a practical project plan from this document
Show me the highest-priority work in my local project

agents.name: Scout
agents.description: The talent scout. Researches your market, finds keyword opportunities, writes articles and makes the images for them.
examplePrompts: Research sportsinsightmedia.com.au and show me article ideas
Write me an SEO article from the strongest idea
Generate a header image for that article

agents.name: Closer
agents.description: The finisher. Handles enquiries, writes outreach, and turns calls into proposals.
examplePrompts: Draft a reply to this enquiry that just came in
Turn these call notes into a recap and a proposal
What do we already know about this company?

agents.name: Coach
agents.description: Campaign planning, positioning, and marketing operations.

agents.name: Selector
agents.description: Investment research, analysis, and decision preparation.

agents.name: Keeper
agents.description: Guards the books. Bookkeeping preparation, review, and reconciliation.
